robot_implementation.py — interactive demo

source: —
detector: Faster R-CNN · Pascal VOC · energy OOD
labeler: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct → Qwen3-VL-8B → you
robot assistant (“where are my …?”) →

This page talks to a local Flask server (robot_web_app.py) running the real pipeline — pick a sample image, step through a frame of one of the sample videos, or upload your own image, then run it through the Faster R-CNN + energy OOD detector and the Qwen3-VL stages. If anything is still unknown after both VLM passes, type its name below to resolve it yourself — the same job ask_user_for_label() does at the console, stage 3.
